businesses.business: Private markets investment management and lending

offering_description.value: Ridgepost Capital gives investors access to middle- and lower-middle-market private equity through funds of funds, secondary funds, co-investments, and stakes in private markets sponsors. It provides project finance, small-business loans, venture debt, portfolio-backed fund financing, and direct loans to lower-middle-market companies. Its investment teams use industry relationships and proprietary data to source opportunities, including investments in venture capital funds and technology startups.

quotes.quote: Ridgepost Capital focuses on identifying and leveraging opportunities for long-term value creation. Through our strategies, RCP Advisors and Bonaccord Capital Partners in North America, and Qualitas Funds in Europe, we offer investors unrivaled access to a deep network of relationships and crucial resources in the middle and lower middle market.

Ridgepost Capital opens doors to alternative credit investing in the lower middle market through our strategies, Enhanced Capital, Western Technology Investment (WTI), Hark Capital, Five Points Capital, and Stellus Capital Management.

primary_products.value: Private equity funds of funds, secondary funds and co-investment funds; private markets sponsor-stake investments; private credit loans; venture capital investments

quotes.quote: RCP Advisors is a private equity investment firm that provides access to lower middle market private equity fund managers through primary funds-of-funds, secondary funds, and co-investment funds, as well as provides advisory and investment research services.
Ridgepost Capital provides investment opportunities in high-performing, access-constrained venture capital firms and technology startups through our strategy, TrueBridge.
